system_overview: ecommerce-returns is a self-serve returns portal with label generation and refunds. It is built as a small focused system with Return Wizard at its core, supported by Label Service (EasyPost) and Refund Orchestrator.

recommended_language.rationale: TypeScript fits the self-serve returns portal with label generation and refunds workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Return Wizard as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The self-serve returns portal with label generation and refunds hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Refund Orchestrator asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Order, ReturnCase, Label must persist relationally
Components: Return Wizard, Label Service (EasyPost), Refund Orchestrator
